mechanism: Foscarnet causes dose-dependent nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair mesalamine absorption and increase GI side effects; additive nephrotoxicity risk in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and urinary output closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider mesalamine dose adjustment if significant renal dysfunction develops during foscarnet therapy.
